```yaml
name: Deploy OfficeIMO Website

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'Website/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-website.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'Website/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-website.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: "pages-${{ github.ref }}"
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout OfficeIMO
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Checkout PSWriteOffice (for API ingestion)
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: EvotecIT/PSWriteOffice
          path: C:\Support\GitHub\PSWriteOffice
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: potatoqualitee/psmoduleinstall@v3
        with:
          modules: InvokeBuild, Plaster, PSScriptAnalyzer

      - name: Build Website and Generate Docs
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # Ensure the target directory exists
          if (-not (Test-Path "C:\Support\GitHub\PSWriteOffice")) {
            Write-Warning "PSWriteOffice root not found, skipping API ingestion fallback"
          }
          
          # Run the build script as specified in validation
          # -SkipBuildTool: Skip installing build tools if already present or not needed
          # -CI: Run in CI mode
          # -PSWriteOfficeRoot: Path to PSWriteOffice for API doc generation
          ./Website/build.ps1 -SkipBuildTool -CI -PSWriteOfficeRoot "C:\Support\GitHub\PSWriteOffice"

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: ./Website/wwwroot

  deploy:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
```
